XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel supply

  • Component: Diesel filter

  • Fault: Occasionally, the vehicle experiences hesitation and sudden stalling whilst driving, with normal restart.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0087 (Fuel pressure/line – Insufficient value)
  • P1180 (Fuel supply system, low-pressure circuit – Fuel line/fuel filter)
  • Cause: Clogged diesel filter

• Action: Check the condition of the fuel filter and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the driver’s side near the passenger compartment. The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 1.17 hours.
